description: Visualize your stock data effortlessly with this interactive Power BI chart. Simply provide a date series, and you can explore the relationship between stock price and volume seamlessly. The chart supports zooming to focus on specific date ranges and panning to navigate across different periods. A crosshair helps you center your selection, while the scales for both price and volume adjust automatically to match your focus. A fixed tooltip displays dynamic data as you move along the date axis. This versatile chart combines smooth navigation with full interactivity, giving you an intuitive and powerful way to explore your data in Power BI.
